amendment_policy.semver_rules: MAJOR: remove/redefine frozen case meaning or floor policy. MINOR: add cases or non-breaking fields after principal accept. PATCH: typos, notes, generator params that do not change intention/result. Never silently edit a frozen case_id in place — archive + replace under amendment log.

amendment_log.summary: Q1.1 scaffold: schema, empty case set, amendment + floor policy. No domain bulk.
Q1.2 Commerce + Messaging: seeded generators + Tier-A intention cases (draft). Dogfood: invented_honest_label (no in-tree dogfood). Floors still unenforced.

Q1.3 Directory + Telemetry + Project management: seeded generators + Tier-A intention cases (draft). Dogfood: invented_honest_label. All §4.3 family floors met by tag count (still unenforced until Q1.4).

Q1.4: enforce_floors=true (all §4.3 floors already met by tag count); comparator review — demote Mongo/CBL competitive forms on predeclared_native_diff budget/consistency cells to lane_local_only; promote case status draft→ready; add intentional Tier-A gap cases (explain, within, str prefix, damage coverage) and Tier B/C non-blocking classifications (array xform, named component, FTS, vector, geo, change stream). Amendment process unchanged (RQL_Q1_CORPUS.md). Package accept still principal-owned.

Q2.2b: rewrite 15 enrich RQL sources from corpus `from/on/card` dialect to product `using/matching/expect`; rql status remains source. Companion fixture seeding + _key match are product-side (audit/runtime), not case text. Package accept still principal-owned.

Q2 closure: align the unread-within source with the frozen enrich + within + brace-project grammar. The case intention and oracle rule are unchanged; the previous shorthand named a separate messages collection as though it were already an embedded carrier.
